key_concepts: The Law of Conservation of Energy states energy cannot be created nor destroyed
Energy must be changed from one form to another to become beneficial
Energy transformation is the change of energy from one form to another
Some energy is released to the environment during transformations
The total amount of energy never changes
Using fluorescent lamps instead of incandescent bulbs conserves energy
Switching off unused electrical appliances conserves energy
Appliances transform electrical energy into heat, light, or sound
A flat iron transforms electrical energy into heat energy
A television converts electrical energy into heat, light, and sound
Potential energy can be converted to kinetic energy and vice versa
